Enrichment._comment: AI-Agent-1: the book-metadata Enrichment agent commits a field once its calibrated confidence reaches this threshold; otherwise it keeps cross-checking or emits 'unknown'.

Ai._ProviderHealthComment: Prod runs the `ollama` docker service, so bookmeta/distractor/tagsuggestion resolve locally and cost nothing. If that ever changes, REROUTE THEM HERE in Ai:Routes — the code will never silently move them to a paid provider.

ProviderHealth._comment: Startup readiness probe + per-provider circuit breaker for background AI work. At startup every provider referenced by Ai:Routes / Ai:DefaultProvider is probed ONCE: Ollama via GET {Ollama:BaseUrl}/api/tags, OpenAI-family by key presence only (never spends tokens). At runtime a transport failure (DNS/refused/timeout) opens that provider's circuit and calls short-circuit to an empty response until the backoff elapses — a dead Ollama then costs ~0 instead of Ollama:TimeoutSeconds per call. Never changes routing.

RouteAlarm._comment: Sentry warning when one of these tasks resolves via Ai:DefaultProvider instead of an explicit route — the 2026-07-14 shape (pdf.parse silently fell to Ollama and pegged the CPU at ~390%). Throttled per (task, provider): a 106-page PDF raises one event, not 106.

Sentry._comment: DSN comes from the SENTRY_DSN env var only — never commit it. Unset ⇒ Sentry is a complete no-op.
